typed_links.link: A cycle-close is isolated only when it is an undiluted standalone rest or tenure notice (3:30); it stays absorbed when fused with a death notice (3:11) or grafted into a poem's closing verse (5:31). One stated rule now governs the family, including the doubled Samson colophons disclosed at 15:20 and 16:31.

The appendix refrain divides by form and position: bare short forms open units at 18:1 (identical first clause) and 19:1 (vayehi-prefixed, constituents inverted - form corrected on review), while the full two-clause form closes at 17:6 and 21:25, the two being byte-identical and bracketing the whole appendix.

The register criterion distinguishes closure CLAUSES that report entry content (the ch 1 dispossession register, kept whole) from separable closure TAGS (the minor judges' death-and-burial formulas, split per entry); the differentiator is whether the closing element carries the entry's own information or a detachable formula.
